purpose: Turn public-safe unresolved FIELD gaps into bounded contributor missions with evidence-bearing RETURN receipts.
laws: PRIVATE/MEDICAL/MESSAGING ADAPTERS EXCLUDED FROM PUBLIC DECK
representative_interaction: ROLL MISSION → OPEN TARGET → perform one bounded move → PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL → COPY RETURN JSON
known_gap: No submission transport or shared scoreboard by design; contributor returns are copied explicitly and reviewed before repo mutation.
